title: Grateful Dead Live at The Music Box on 1969-04-15

ai_review.summary: Matrix source with clear vocal presence and an intense performance
ai_review.review: The matrix recording captures the show’s intensity while keeping the vocals front‑and‑center, delivering a surprisingly crisp vocal mix despite some overall sound‑quality quirks. Reviewers praise the vocal clarity and recommend this as the go‑to source for this concert.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review highlighting strong vocals and overall intensity; limited data prevents higher confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Vocals are clear and prominent; the rest of the mix is decent but not perfect, with minor sound‑quality imperfections.
